request.style: English, female vocal, warm and hopeful, solo with light choir, piano, acoustic guitar, strings, cello, gentle and uplifting, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We claim the blood of Abraham runs deep
We say we have never been anyone's slave
But you ask how we could ever be truly free
When the chains of sin are heavy and strong

[Chorus]
Truly, truly, I tell you today
Everyone who commits sin is a slave
A slave does not remain in the house
But a son stays forever in his place

[Verse]
If the Son sets you free from the bond
You will be free indeed, truly free
I know your lineage, I know your name
But my word finds no room in your heart

[Chorus]
Truly, truly, I tell you today
Everyone who commits sin is a slave
A slave does not remain in the house
But a son stays forever in his place

[Bridge]
I speak of what I have seen with my Father
You do what you have heard from your father
If you were children of Abraham then
You would do the works that he did

[Outro]
Free indeed, the son remains
Free indeed, the chains are gone
